summary: Vistagen Therapeutics filed a Form 8-K on September 24, 2026, furnishing a press release under Item 8.01 (and Item 9.01) that summarizes positive exploratory efficacy data presented at Psych Congress 2026 in New Orleans. The poster highlights post-hoc and prespecified subpopulation analyses from two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled public speaking challenge trials showing fasedienol nasal spray improved SUDS-measured anxiety versus placebo in very severe social anxiety disorder (baseline LSAS of 95 or higher). No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, stake, or regulatory clock are disclosed; this is a routine clinical data update, not a special situation. Watch for Phase 3 readouts and regulatory filing timing.
